editorial:
Imagine you are a private eye just trying to make a living when a rich woman walks in with a huge pile of money. That is exactly how things start for Ilya Mirsky. He gets hired by Eva, the wife of a powerful media boss, to stop some dirty secrets from getting out. If those secrets leak, she loses a massive inheritance. It starts off as a simple job to protect a reputation, but the vibe quickly shifts from a corporate mystery to a deadly game of cat and mouse. You will feel the tension build as Ilya realizes he is in way over his head.

What really works here are the twists that keep you guessing who is actually pulling the strings. The action scenes are punchy and the pacing never lets up, though some of the older effects might look a bit dated to you. If you love a gritty crime story with a bit of a puzzle, you should definitely give this a shot.
endingExplained: In the final act, you discover that the people Ilya trusted were actually manipulating him all along. The big twist reveals that Eva was not just a victim, but a player in the murder scheme to secure her wealth. After a tense showdown, Ilya manages to outsmart the villains and expose the truth. The movie wraps up with the bad guys facing justice, and Ilya barely escaping with his life, leaving him a bit more cynical than before.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-school detective stories and surprising plot twists.
